classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070401) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070402) molecular function GO terms, run per-sequence biochemical analysis on both sets, and rank the combined representative sequences by aggregated quality metrics to surface the best-characterised NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates.
assumptions: GO:0070401 maps to NAD(P)HX dehydratase (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase) molecular function; if the canonical GO ID differs the dehydratase go_sequences node will return an empty set and the GO ID must be corrected before re-running.
GO:0070402 maps to NADPHX epimerase molecular function; if the canonical GO ID differs the epimerase go_sequences node will return an empty set and the GO ID must be corrected before re-running.
Swiss-Prot reviewed sequences (reviewed=true) are used to maximise annotation quality; if either GO term returns zero sequences, relaxing to reviewed=null is the recommended next step.
pH 7.4 is assumed for charge calculations as NAD(P)HX repair is a cytosolic process.
Up to 200 reviewed sequences per GO term are retrieved; actual counts are expected to be small given the narrow functional annotation scope.
Structural embedding via esm3 is listed as a warm tool for post-round refinement once representative sequences are confirmed; it is not required to produce an initial ranking.
Literature search runs in parallel with sequence retrieval to surface biological context; its output does not gate downstream node execution.
rank_designs aggregates both dehydratase and epimerase representative sequence sets; the joint ranking reflects coverage across both NAD(P)HX repair activities.

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences on GO:0070401 returns kept_sequences >= 1 and a valid fasta_path
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences on GO:0070402 returns kept_sequences >= 1 and a valid fasta_path
success_criteria.analyses_complete: Both sequence_analysis nodes return representative_sequences and metrics without errors
success_criteria.ranking_produced: rank_designs returns ranked_candidates with at least 1 entry and a ranked_tsv artifact covering both activity classes

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair ADP-dependent dehydratase epimerase NADPHX
